messages.subject: r-batch files included in GRASS GIS: error ""\R.exe"" false or not found
messages.subject_clean: r-batch files included in GRASS GIS: error ""\R.exe"" false or not found
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

some time ago I've added the r batch files to GRASS GIS for a smooth R-winGRASS integration. [1]

invoking R within a GRASS GIS session worked fine (see screenshots in the mentioned wiki).

now I'm getting follow error (original in german, translated to englisch):

"Der Befehl ""\R.exe"" ist entweder falsch geschrieben oder konnte nicht gefunden werden."

"The command ""\R.exe"" is wrong or couldn't be found."

the r-batch files are living in:

C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin

This folder is included in %PATH%.

when I open a MS windows command line and switch manually to C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin, the r-batch files work quite nice (see also [2]):

C:\Users\xxxxx>cd C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin

C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin>R

R version 3.1.2 (2014-10-31) -- "Pumpkin Helmet"
Copyright (C) 2014 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

R ist freie Software und kommt OHNE JEGLICHE GARANTIE.
Sie sind eingeladen, es unter bestimmten Bedingungen weiter zu verbreiten.
Tippen Sie 'license()' or 'licence()' für Details dazu.

R ist ein Gemeinschaftsprojekt mit vielen Beitragenden.
Tippen Sie 'contributors()' für mehr Information und 'citation()',
um zu erfahren, wie R oder R packages in Publikationen zitiert werden
können.

Tippen Sie 'demo()' für einige Demos, 'help()' für on-line Hilfe, oder
'help.start()' für eine HTML Browserschnittstelle zur Hilfe.
Tippen Sie 'q()', um R zu verlassen.

> q()
Workspace sichern? [y/n/c]: n

C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin>

maybe a path issue? any idea?

thanks and kind regards
Helmut

[1] http://grasswiki.osgeo.org/wiki/R_statistics#GRASS_7_Usage
[2] http://lists.osgeo.org/pipermail/grass-dev/2015-March/074561.html

messages.body_plain:
The error message says its looking for R.exe in \  which is clearly the wrong place to look.    Remove the @echo off at the top of whatever batch file you are running and examine the output and that might lead you to the problem.  Its likely something specific to your system in which case you will need to do track it down yourself.

messages.subject: moving to github
messages.body_plain:
Just an announcement that with google's upcoming closing of googlecode, my packages will be moving to github.   This was somewhat forseeable (Google's Go language had already migrated to github) but its finally happened.  I had been using github for some projects already but now I will be formally moving them all over.

My packages will be found here.  So far sqldf has been moved over and others will be moved over over time:
   http://github.com/ggrothendieck

In most cases its best to use the CRAN version of a package but for anyone who needs to run the development version use code such as this from within R to install the package directly from github:

   # install.packages("devtools")
   devtools::install_github("ggrothendieck/sqldf")
